name: multi-layout-accordion

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows all three answers expanded together, which is the behaviour this variant exists for.

tagline: A question list where several answers can stay open together.
summary: A single column of FAQ rows that can all be expanded at once. Each question opens its answer in place and stays open while others are opened, without collapsing the rest.
appearance: A single column of dark rounded question bars under a small heading, each row ending in a chevron. Open rows show a pale header and a block of grey answer text below, with up to three answers visible at the same time.
behaviour: Clicking a question toggles its answer open or shut with a short height animation. Because the list allows multiple open at once, opening one leaves the others expanded, so all three answers can be shown together.
demo_content: Three questions about UI components: What is a UI component?, Why are UI components important? and Key characteristics.
use_when: You want a compact FAQ where readers can compare several answers without reopening each one.
avoid_when: With everything expanded the page gets long, and the demo shows only three short answers.
customise: The three questions and answers are typed into the JSX, and the initially open item is set by a default value. Row styling comes from the shared accordion pieces.
weight_why: Three text rows with a height transition when toggled.

a11y.note: Rows rely on the pale header to show open, and the header markup is not shown, so focus is unverified.

issues: The chevron does not visibly change on open, so the pale header is the only state cue.
Answers use small muted text on dark panels, which is hard to read at this size.
polish_why: Neat single-column FAQ; the flat rows and static chevrons keep it ordinary.
title: Multi Open Accordion
